question: The concept of Public Interest Litigation originated in __________.
solution: The correct answer is __**USA**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The concept of Public Interest Litigation (PIL) originated in the United States of America (USA). • PIL allows individuals or groups to file lawsuits to protect the public interest. • It enables the courts to consider matters that affect the public at large, not just the interests of the individuals directly involved in the case. • The concept was introduced to address issues such as environmental protection, consumer welfare, and human rights.
